overlays.label: Politically exposed person
overlays.description: A verified PEP relationship, or an open PEP signal on the case.

requireApproval.reason: Senior approval to establish a relationship with a politically exposed person (candidate - two case reviewers until a senior-management role exists).

overlays.label: High-risk geography
overlays.description: Exposure to a country on the institution's high-risk list (candidate list from the FATF call for action; the owner maintains it).

overlays.label: Complex or opaque ownership
overlays.description: Three or more recorded ownership interests.

overlays.label: Confirmed adverse media
overlays.description: A confirmed adverse-media event about the customer or a connected party.

overlays.label: High transactional risk
overlays.description: A transaction risk factor scored 0.7 or more, for payment products (cards, merchant acquiring and payments).

overlays.label: Assessed high risk
overlays.description: The case's assessed risk tier is HIGH. Off until the risk skills' tier reaches this gate; simulate it with the what-if's assessed-risk input.
